<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"List a site's locations by role"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sites/{siteCode}/locations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Answers "where are this site's dock doors" (or any other LocationRole) without walking the full nested site layout (ADR-0016). Results are ordered zone → aisle → bay → level → position, like getSiteLayout's slots. Keyset-paginated: `limit` and `cursor`; follow `nextCursor` until it is absent.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

  parameters={[{"name":"limit","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Page size, 1-500 (default 100). An empty, repeated, non-integer or out-of-range value is 400 `invalid-limit`.","schema":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":500,"default":100}},{"name":"cursor","in":"query","required":false,"description":"Opaque page token: the `nextCursor` of the previous page, with the same filters repeated. Storage is the default and only role that existed before this ADR; the rest cover non-storage functional locations that previously had no place on the map at all.\n","enum":["Storage","Dock","Yard","WorkCenter","Drop","Staging","QC","Consolidation","Shipping"],"example":"Storage","title":"LocationRole"},"example":"Dock"}]}
